intent: Recognize explicit read-only questions about the selected repository and make one bounded evidence-acquisition retry when a GitHub task returns prose before any repository operation.
acceptance: Selected repository context is included for explicit read-only project and codebase questions.
Unrelated conversational requests do not inherit the selected repository.
A prose-only GitHub round with available tools and no receipts gets one evidence-acquisition retry.
A second prose-only round terminates without looping, and final synthesis after a receipt is unchanged.
